name: EmploymentHistoryEditor
tagline: The Employment History Editor lets people enter their work history on a form: every role and every career break, with the month and year it started and ended.
description: The Employment History Editor lets people enter their work history on a form: every role and every career break, with the month and year it started and ended. While they type, the control adds up their total experience, draws a timeline, and points out gaps and overlaps so the application arrives complete the first time.
features: Edit and remove roles and career breaks with month-year dates
See total experience (overlaps merged, breaks excluded)
Required-coverage and minimum-experience checks, overlap rules
One-click 'add career break' for a gap, type filter, sorting, undo
Read-only and masked states and a stacked phone layout
Stores the history as JSON in a text column
